poses.label: Setup
poses.description: Hold the bar at shoulder width with palms up and arms long.

poses.label: Curl
poses.description: Bend your elbows to lift the bar while keeping your upper arms beside your ribs.

poses.label: Top
poses.description: Finish the curl without leaning or letting your elbows travel.

poses.label: Lower
poses.description: Lower the bar slowly until your arms are long again.

checks: Palms-up grip, upright torso, fixed upper arms, controlled return.
Compared pose captions with the exact built-in exercise cue.
Checked camera bounds, equipment anchoring, and contact throughout the interpolated loop.
limitations: The simplified figure and fixed camera show the main movement path. In-app phone playback and admin review are pending.
The fixed camera and full-size plates can partially obscure the hands or bar.

source.artwork: Original. Drawn in code from the shared rig in web/js/guides.js.
